knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Dry sweeping disturbs settled dust, which can then be inhaled.
Controls at the source come before personal protection.
A control that is absent or cannot be checked means stopping and reporting.

practicalCriteria: Confirms the dust-control method before a simulated cleaning task.
Avoids dry sweeping and compressed air on a simulated settled-dust area.
Stops and reports when a simulated control is absent.
passRule: Control confirmed, no dry sweeping or compressed air, and stop-and-report applied when the control is absent. Observed by an assessor.
stopWorkCriteria: Dry sweeping or compressed air used on settled silica dust
Dust control absent or cannot be checked
Household vacuum used on respirable dust
